preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= goals <= 100 for goals in goals_list)
preconditions.description: The number of goals scored by each team in any match must be between 0 and 100.
The length of each team's name must not exceed 10 characters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the names of the top-ranked and second top-ranked teams separated by a space.
The top-ranked team and the second top-ranked team must be different.

postconditions.expression: all(team in team_names for team in [top_team, second_team])
postconditions.description: The top-ranked and second top-ranked teams must be valid team names from the input.
